title: Product Manager
description:
**About Minga**

  

At Minga, we’re creating the Student Behavior Platform schools can’t imagine running without. We’re on a mission to make school life run smoother and have fun while we’re at it.

  

We’re a tight\-knit team of curious, creative, and low\-ego humans who genuinely enjoy working together. We care deeply about the work we do and the people we do it with and that shows up in how we lead, collaborate, and celebrate.  

  

Our culture is built on trust, ownership, and continuous learning. Whether you’re working from our Kelowna HQ or remotely, you’ll have the autonomy to do your best work, the support to grow, and the opportunity to make a real impact in the lives of educators and students.  

  

We believe in visible, people\-first leadership. Our Leadership team is hands\-on and accessible, with monthly lunch \& learns, open dialogue, and real\-time connection. If you’re energized by meaningful challenges, driven by purpose, and ready to help shape something that’s scaling fast and staying human; you might’ve just found your people.

 **The Role**

  

We’re not just hiring to fill a seat. We’re adding a teammate. Someone who loves solving messy problems, cares deeply about customers, and gets excited by the chance to shape what’s next at Minga.

  

Reporting to the VP of Product,  

this **Product Manager role** is all about turning school data into clarity, insight, and real\-world impact for teachers, administrators, and staff. You’ll work across reporting, analytics and integrations. You will help schools create a positive school culture and behaviour with informed decision making with Minga.

  

You **don’t** need to be an engineer or a data scientist. You ***do*** need to be comfortable with technology, curious about how systems work together, and excited about the possibilities of AI to improve how educators access and understand information.

  

If you’re **scrappy, collaborative, and love learning** your way through the unknown—you’ll feel right at home.

 **What You’ll Do**


* Lead product areas focused on data, reporting, and integrations, including teacher/admin dashboards, school\-wide insights, and how data flows between Minga, SIS systems, and other platforms.
* Collaborate with our data partner and internal teams to expand the data Minga can ingest and improve how we write data back to SIS and other district systems.
* Explore early AI opportunities, like translating complex data into simple stories for educators or reducing manual workflows between systems.
* Meet with customers regularly to uncover the real pain points behind their data and reporting needs.
* Turn those insights into clear requirements, prototypes, and product improvements that deliver measurable impact.
* Define success metrics, track them, and use data to drive decisions that improve outcomes for schools.
* Work closely with Engineering, Design, Customer Success, and Go\-to\-Market teams to plan, build, ship, and iterate on your work.
* Embrace discovery, test assumptions often, and bring structure to ambiguous problem spaces.

  


**What We Require**


* 3–5 years of product management experience, ideally in SaaS.
* Experience working with data, reporting, analytics, or integrations (comfortable with technical concepts, even if you’re not “technical”).
* Strong customer empathy, you know how to ask great questions, listen deeply, and turn insights into decisions.
* A collaborative, low\-ego approach to working with designers, engineers, and customer facing teams.
* A comfort with ambiguity, you enjoy figuring things out and shaping the path forward.
* Ability to use data to inform prioritization and product direction.
* Interest in or familiarity with AI, and curiosity about how it can improve data communication and cross\-system workflows.
* **Bonus: Experience in edtech, K\-12 environments, or school SIS systems (not required).**
  


**Who You Are**


* You’re naturally curious and love learning new systems, tools, and domains.
* You’re entrepreneurial and scrappy. You figure things out even when there’s no playbook.
* You’re collaborative, thoughtful, and excited to work in a low\-ego environment.
* You take ownership and love the craft of building great products.
* You’re motivated by purpose and energized by the chance to make school life better.

  


**How We Work (and What We Value)**



Our values guide how we show up, make decisions, and grow together:  

  

Growth – We’re always learning and evolving, individually and as a team  

Respect – We value every voice and listen with intention  

Integrity – We do what’s right, even when it’s hard  

Passion – We bring energy, heart, and purpose to everything we do

 **What You Can Expect at Minga**


**A flexible approach to work:** Hybrid\-first working model allowing for in\-office connection with a side of remote flexibility. We do offer fully remote based opportunities depending on the role with option to work in our Kelowna HQ office location.

 **Supportive, visible leadership:** Monthly CEO lunch \& learns, transparent updates, and a leadership that genuinely listens.

 **Culture of connection:** Monthly team lunches, happy hours, social events, and 2 annual offsite events to bring us all together

 **Learning \& development:** Dedicated time and budget to invest in your growth

 **Celebrating the wins:** From Slack shoutouts to company\-wide moments, we pause to recognize the progress, big and small

 **Perks with Purpose:**


* Equitable compensation and pay transparency on all roles
* Flexible paid time off including vacation \+ additional personal days
* Comprehensive health, dental and vision benefits for you and your family
* Mental health and wellness support
* A team that leads with heart and loves what they do

  


**Sound like your kind of place? Apply now, we’d love to meet you.**

 **What You Can Expect From Us**



At Minga, we don’t take it lightly that you’re considering us as your next move and we treat every application with the care and attention it deserves. You won’t be left wondering if your resume disappeared into the void. Every application is reviewed by a real person on our team.  

  

We’ll keep you in the loop, communicate clearly, and make sure you feel seen and respected throughout the process.  

  

If this role feels like a fit, or even a maybe, hit that apply button. We’re genuinely excited to learn more about you.  

  

Let’s build something meaningful together.

title: Data Scientist con 5 años de experiencia
description:
Qué harás

A corto plazo, participarás en dos proyectos: un detector de anomalías para un gestor de plantas renovables y un proyecto para una gran cadena de gimnasios.

En esos proyectos:

* Liderarás el planteamiento de los modelos de Machine Learning a aplicar y las métricas a utilizar, en los proyectos que participes, así como de su puesta en producción.
* Te encargarás del desarrollo end\-to\-end de los proyectos en los que participes: extraer los datos (Big Query, Redshift), realizar el EDA (usando Plotly), entrenar los modelos (con pipelines de Sklearn), crear una aplicación con FastAPI y Dash para consumir el modelo, si es necesario y desplegar la solución en la infraestructura del cliente (Docker, Dokploy, Cloud Run, etc.). Todo ello, quedará encapsulado en una librería de Python instalable, documentada y testada.

Además del trabajo en proyectos, te encargarás de dar soporte a los científicos de datos con menor experiencia dentro del equipo.

Qué pedimos

* Experiencia de al menos 5 años trabajando en proyectos de datos/IA/ML.
* Ser capaz de desarrollar código limpio, entendible y mantenible en Python. Nuestros proyectos son propiedad de nuestros clientes, así que debemos crear soluciones robustas, mantenibles y profesionales.
* Experiencia en el planteamiento y desarrollo de modelos de ML. Ante todo, en DECIDATA solucionamos problemas de negocio con IA, ML, Analítica Avanzada. Tenemos proyectos de predicción numérica, clasificación, RAGs, optimizadores… Contar con experiencia a la hora de crear modelos de ML, crear Pipelines robustos que facilitan la puesta en producción, saber identificar y resolver posibles problemas antes de abordar un proyecto es imprescindible.
* Conocimiento de creación de APIs y Frontends. No somos desarrolladores full\-stack, pero a veces tenemos que crear APIs y Fronts para que el cliente pueda consumir nuestra aplicación. Necesitamos que te hayas peleado creando algún que otro front (nosotros usamos Dash, pero si has trabajado con otro framework o con HTML y CSS puro es válido) y tengas experiencia en la creación de APIs (nosotros usamos FastAPI, pero si has trabajado con otro framework no hay problema).
* Conocimiento de Infra \& despliegue. Al igual que no somos full\-stack, tampoco somos devops. Sin embargo, tenemos que desplegar los proyectos en la infra del cliente. Hemos trabajado con Google Cloud, Azure, despliegues en VMs…
* Soft skills: capacidad de trabajar en equipo, ser autónomo en la ejecución de tareas, de liderar reuniones técnicas con cliente, tener ganas de seguir aprendiendo y mejorando, etc.

Qué ofrecemos

* Paquete salarial de 50\.700€ compuesto por: sueldo de 43\.000€ brutos/año, 10% de bonus y 3\.000€ para formación.
* Horario flexible y jornada intensiva los viernes.
* 23 días de vacaciones al año \+ el día de tu cumpleaños libre. Libertad para organizarte tus vacaciones.
* Plan de Carrera definido con criterios claros y objetivos para evolucionar dentro de la compañía.
* Comida gratis los días que vengas a la oficina y el mejor pintxo de tortilla los días que estamos todos juntos.
* Formación continua: reuniones semanales dentro del equipo técnico para compartir conocimientos generados en los proyectos (technical stuff), formación mensual dentro de la compañía y 3\.000€ de presupuesto al año para que puedas formarte.
* Acompañamiento en tu carrera profesional por una persona con más experiencia. One\-to\-one semanal, reuniones trimestrales de seguimiento con el CEO para evaluar tu evolución profesional.

Dónde lo harás

Nuestras oficinas están ubicadas en Bilbao y valoramos la cultura de equipo que se genera en la oficina, por lo que nuestra preferencia es un modelo de trabajo híbrido.

Es importante destacar que, independientemente de la modalidad, el puesto implica visitas ocasionales a las oficinas de nuestros clientes en etapas estratégicas de los proyectos.

Cómo lo harás

Nos organizamos mediante metodologías ágiles, fomentando la transparencia y la comunicación continua entre todos los involucrados:

\- Todos los lunes realizamos una reunión de coordinación para planificar la semana en la que se definen las tareas a desarrollar por cada uno.

\- Utilizamos Jira y Teams como herramientas para la comunicación y la gestión de proyectos.

Tendrás autonomía para planificar y ejecutar tus tareas, con el apoyo de equipos de negocio y técnicos siempre que lo necesites.

Creemos en la confianza y en la responsabilidad compartida, donde cada persona aporta su experiencia para el éxito colectivo.

Cómo presentar tu candidatura

¡Es muy sencillo! Solo tienes que rellenar la solicitud a través de LinkedIn o enviarnos tu CV a info@decidata.es poniendo en el cuerpo Científico de datos Senior ¡Estamos deseando conocerte!

Si disfrutas convirtiendo los retos de negocio en soluciones de IA de alto impacto y te motiva aportar tu visión en cada fase del proyecto, DECIDATA es el lugar perfecto para ti. ¡Te esperamos!

Beneficios:

* Flexibilidad horaria
* Teletrabajo opcional

**WELCOME TO OLX** **At OLX, we work together to build a more sustainable world through trade**.
We make it safe, smart, and convenient to buy and sell cars, find housing, get jobs, buy and sell household goods, and more. Our colleagues around the world help to serve millions of people around the world every month, through its well\-loved consumer brands including OLX, Otodom, AutoTrader, Property24\.**Join OLX and see how far you can go**. **About the role**  

As a Senior Product Manager in the Consumers Tribe, you will play a pivotal role in achieving our core mission: building a loveable discovery experience powered by AI for millions of property seekers across key EU markets (Otodom, Storia, Imovirtual). Your specific mandate is to be the driving force behind the quality and completeness of every property ad on our platform, ensuring our inventory offers the very best selection. The quality and completeness of a property ad directly dictate the trust, efficiency, and speed of the seeker's journey. **Please note that this role is based in Spain. Remote work within Spain is possible; however, you must be based in and legally eligible to work in Spain. Remote work from outside Spain is not possible.**
### **What you will be doing**

* Be the first advocate for Seeker experience and Property Ad Quality across the organization
* Define and own the long\-term vision and strategy for content enrichment, delivering innovative solutions that leverage AI to transform the property discovery experience
* Drive the AI innovations agenda by closely collaborating with Data Science
* Define the quarterly OKRs for your domain and own the execution of the product roadmap, clearly articulating the rationale and business impact.
* Provide guidance to the product development team to deliver valuable features that impact the way our users interact with the platform
* Conduct experiments and run A/B tests to understand which initiatives will have the most impact on success metrics you defined
* Create and prioritize hypotheses, initiate user research and work with product analysts, data scientists, tech leads and UX researchers to understand user problems and verify ideas
* Collaborate with other teams to enable them to deliver marketplace\-enhancing features
* Manage stakeholders across business and engineering to ensure alignment on strategy, delivery, and vision.

### **Your Profile:**

* Extensive years of experience in product management \- ideally within an international set\-up and at a high\-traffic consumer Internet or e\-commerce company
* Proven track record of defining and successfully delivering product strategies within high\-growth, consumer\-facing technology companies
* Exceptional cross\-functional leadership and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence, negotiate and drive alignment
* Highly impact/outcome\-oriented mindset demonstrated by a track record of using data and experimentation to drive measurable user or business impact
* Experience with seeker/buyer\-facing products
* Curiosity! – initiative to dig into the why \& what
* Experience in hypothesis and data\-based product development, e.g., user and market research, validating ideas, experimentation, A/B testing, usability testing, data analysis
* Capability to understand technical concepts and discuss deep technical topics with development teams
* Experience working in a complex matrix organisation
* Excellent written and oral communication skills. Proficient English is required
* Experience in the Real Estate industry is a plus

### **What we’ll give you**

* Outstanding opportunity to become a part of an international team of committed people learning from one another and contributing to the global Naspers Classifieds success.
* Great place to learn and develop within a fast\-growing, global classifieds leader which opens further career opportunities in the diverse world of OLX and Prosus.
* Fun and informal environment where getting stuff done and enjoying the ride is far more important than rules and hierarchies
* You will have perks like company self\-service, food supply, bonus system for good performance, and others.
* Attractive salary (base \+ annual bonus).

**Diversity, Equity and Inclusion at OLX**
OLX values diversity and welcomes applicants of all races, ethnicities, disabilities, ages, genders, sexual orientations, religions, backgrounds, and experiences to apply. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet all the requirements \- you may be just the right fit for this or other opportunities with us! *OLX will process your personal data to assess your fit for the applied position. You may optionally consent to store your data for up to 12 months after the application process for consideration in future OLX roles. For more details on how your application data will be processed please check our* *Privacy Statement**.*

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. Our mission is to build intelligent, scalable systems that proactively identify fraud, prevent abuse, and ensure the integrity of user activity without compromising on performance or user experience. * Design, develop, and assess AI models focused on detecting P2P scams, with a particular emphasis on document verification and payment proof tampering.
* Research and prototype large language model (LLM)\-based solutions to enhance automated detection, generate interpretable rule\-based explanations, and support scam pattern discovery.
* Investigate and implement cutting\-edge image embedding techniques to extract meaningful features for downstream applications such as clustering and classification.
* Collaborate closely with data scientists and engineers to optimize the detection pipeline and deliver actionable insights to key stakeholders.

### **Requirements**

* Currently enrolled as a full\-time or part\-time undergraduate, Master’s, or PhD student, or a recent graduate.
* Solid understanding of AI principles and mathematical foundations, including deep learning, generative AI, reinforcement learning, prompt engineering, and optimization techniques.
* Strong interest in Agentic Prompt Engineering and its applications.

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Commitment to a minimum duration of 1 year.
* Proficiency in programming languages, particularly Python and SQL.
* Practical experience in developing computer vision and/or image analysis models.


Why Binance* Shape the future with the world’s leading blockchain ecosystem
* Collaborate with world\-class talent in a user\-centric global organization with a flat structure
* Tackle unique, fast\-paced projects with autonomy in an innovative environment
* Thrive in a results\-driven workplace with opportunities for career growth and continuous learning
* Competitive salary and company benefits

title: Data Science Lead
description:
**About Gridsight**


Electricity grids are undergoing the most significant transformation in a century. The shift to renewables, the proliferation of rooftop solar, batteries, and EVs, and the increasing complexity of distribution networks are forcing utilities to operate their grids in fundamentally new ways.


Gridsight builds the analytics platform that makes this possible. We're already embedded with most of Australia's major distribution networks and have contracts with some of the largest investor\-owned utilities in the United States. We're well\-funded, growing quickly, and positioned at the centre of a global shift toward dynamic grid management.

 **The Role**


We're hiring a Data Science Lead to build and run the data science function at Gridsight.


You'll manage a team of data scientists (initially 3\+), set the technical vision and strategy for the function, and establish the practices that enable high\-quality, production\-ready work. You'll work closely with our CEO who has deep technical experience in the domain, and our VP of Engineering to ensure data science capabilities align with product and commercial goals — and you'll stay hands\-on technically, contributing directly where needed.


This is a leadership role with real scope. You'll shape how data science operates at Gridsight: team structure, workflows, standards, and technical direction. You'll guide work across grid modelling, optimisation, and emerging capabilities. And you'll be a key voice in translating customer problems into technical roadmaps.


We're building toward a layered vision of grid analytics, optimisation engines, and agentic workflows. You'll be responsible for developing the team and capabilities to deliver it.

**What You'll Do**

* Manage and develop the data science team, fostering technical growth and high performance
* Set data science vision and strategy in collaboration with engineering leadership
* Establish best practices across model selection, experimental design, validation, and deployment
* Contribute hands\-on to technical work where needed, flexing into gaps across modelling, optimisation, or new capabilities
* Collaborate with commercial and product teams to translate customer needs into technical roadmaps
* Guide the team on appropriate model complexity — balancing rigour with practical delivery
* Contribute to technical strategy and architectural decisions alongside engineering leadership
* Foster a collaborative, learning\-oriented culture in a scale\-up environment

**What You'll Bring**

* Experience building, managing, and developing data science teams
* Strong data science foundations: statistical modelling, ML, experimental design, and the judgment to set standards and guide technical decisions
* Experience shaping data science functions, workflows, and team structures
* Ability to collaborate with non\-technical stakeholders and translate business problems into technical solutions
* Hands\-on technical capability — you can contribute directly, not just oversee
* Leadership experience in a senior or management capacity

**What Would Set You Apart**

* Experience with decision engines or recommendation systems
* Grid domain knowledge or energy sector experience
* Optimisation expertise
* Scale\-up or high\-growth company experience
* Software engineering and MLOps depth
* Experience managing distributed or remote teams

**What We Offer**

* $190,000–$230,000\+ depending on experience, plus equity
* Remote\-first, with head office in Sydney
* A talented team of engineers, data scientists, and power systems specialists working on hard problems that matter

**Sound Interesting?**


We'd love to hear from you! Apply directly and we'll be in touch shortly.

**Nuffield Department of Orthopaedics, Rheumatology and Musculoskeletal Sciences (NDORMS)**
**Grade 8: Salary in the range of £49,119\-£55,031** **per annum**
**This is a fixed\-term, full time position for 3 years, in the first instance**

We are looking for a Senior Bioinformatician in Exposome Immunology to join the Nuffield Department of Orthopaedics, Rheumatology and Musculoskeletal Sciences at the University of Oxford. The post\-holder will co\-lead development of a CoRE computational pipeline that integrates multi\-omic data at the cellular level across exposomes and diseases, revealing novel biology and shared mechanisms of immune regulation. They will work with a team of data scientists in Manchester and Oxford towards the development of the integrated omics data analysis pipeline within the CoRE, creating omics\-based tissue atlases and associated computational models to characterise the effect of exposures on different tissues in humans and model systems.

As a Senior Bioinformatician, you will be responsible for identifying, defining and planning new projects, taking overall or shared responsibility for development of the CoRE computational pipeline for integration of omics data with other relevant datasets. You will manage CoRE data scientists to support the CoRE programme objectives and work closely with experimental and clinical partners to better understand the domain, help address scientific hypotheses and support the CoRE programme objectives. In addition, you will advise and supervise CoRE staff and students on the associated CoRE PhD programme on a day\-to\-day basis.
  

You must hold a PhD/DPhil with a significant computational and/or statistical element, or comparable industrial research experience. You must have expertise in bioinformatics analysis of omics datasets, including single\-cell and spatial multi\-omics. Previous experience applying machine learning/AI methods, including experience and knowledge of python programming, is essential. Experience of developing computational methods for omics data analysis, along with experience and knowledge of another relevant programming language (e.g. R), is desirable.

This is a fixed\-term, full time position for 3 years, in the first instance.

**The Role**


Energia Group have an exciting opportunity for a Data Scientist based in Belfast.


Energia Group seeks to appoint an experienced Data Scientist to join our growing Group Data Office, reporting to the Head of Data \& Analytics. You will work closely with your colleagues in our Group Data Office within Technology \& Innovation (T\&I), and with senior managers and teams across our businesses to identify, prioritise, plan, and execute on opportunities to derive business value from data. You will bring up\-to\-date technical knowledge in data science and a passion for innovation and change; our business teams will bring an understanding of transformational outcomes they wish to achieve and their priorities; together you will forge a successful partnership to deliver data\-led change that will benefit for our business and customers.


Your work will involve problem definition, problem solving, and effective working with colleagues. You will lead on problem structuring, data sourcing and transformation, model building and testing, model deployment to production, and post\-production evaluation and updating. Your technical expertise will cover the full spectrum data science techniques (statistical models, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence), development principles and best practices, and key software tools. Some solutions may require descriptive analytics for business insights, so your knowledge of reporting tools Power BI will be useful.

**What you'll need**

* A bachelor’s degree in computer science, data science, engineering, or related field.
* Extensive post\-academic experience in Data Analytics, Data Science and/or Machine Learning; with a proficiency in SQL, Python and Databricks.
* Experience and knowledge of statistical modelling techniques such as GLM regression, logistic regression, log\-linear regression, deep learning, Bayesian methods, bagging \& boosting techniques, clustering, sampling, variable selection, feature engineering and extraction, developing ML (Machine Learning) pipelines in data factory \- MLOps, A/B experimentation, Git, model monitoring and leader board maintenance with MLFlow, code exception handling, code modularisation and unit testing.

* Experience working in an agile manner, constantly seeking the most efficient methods to deliver against business objectives.

 Data Scientist (Remote)
   

  

**PRIMARY PURPOSE OF THE ROLE:** 
 To develop and manage predictive modeling assignments through completion; to communicate results; to make recommendations to management; and to ensure model ownership, implementation, and monitoring; to spot trends and to gain maximum insight that can give the company a competitive advantage.
   

  

**ARE YOU AN IDEAL CANDIDATE?** 
 We are looking for enthusiastic candidates who thrive in a collaborative environment, who are driven to deliver great work, are customer\-oriented and are naturally empathetic.
   

  

**Essential Responsiblities May Include**
* Execute data science projects as identified by Sr Data Scientists, leadership, and stakeholders
* Help to build, prototype, and deploy machine learning models in sandbox and production environments
* Produce reports to communicate metrics and outcomes of stakeholder interest
* Assist with developing and maintaining end\-to\-end ETL data pipelines
* Work to explore new internal data sources and their utility within projects
* Communicate modeling challenges, findings, and outcomes to stakeholders


**Qualifications**
* Insurance claims knowledge preferred
* Minimum one year of predictive modeling, data science, and analysis experience with solid background in the using data visualization tools and libraries and data exploration, data wrangling, and feature engineering
* Experience writing Python or R code, and notebook environments
* Knowledge of common unsupervised/supervised ML techniques


**TAKING CARE OF YOU**
* Career development and promotional growth opportunities.
* A diverse and comprehensive benefits offering including medical, dental vision, 401k, PTO and more.
